name: Sol d'Lockes
source:
The second son of the d'Lockes family. Unexpectedly appointed the heir by his father when he was still young. Sol bears the responsibility of the d'Lockes name on his shoulders. He conducts his duties with princely grace, yet there is something heartbreaking beneath that smile of his. What secrets are hidden in his heart?
